title: Arrow Selector
description: Allows you to put arrows above the bows to have prioraty access
body:
a VERY small mod that does one thing, makes bows select arrows two slots above it (top row of inventory)

This is useful for!
1. bowswapping, debuff an enemy with weakness, slowness and glowing to mark them asa prioraty target
2. buffing your allieswith strength, speed, or instant healing.
3. making it look like you have only regular arrows, when infact, you have instant harming two on a power 5 bow
